Top 10 Oil and gas Contracting Companies in Abu Dhabi
Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), is a global center for the oil and gas industry. With its substantial reserves of natural resources, Abu Dhabi plays a critical role in the world’s energy supply chain. The region is home to some of the top contracting companies that offer services ranging from expedition and drilling to construction, engineering, and upkeep of oil and gas infrastructure.
As of 2024, the oil and gas industry in the UAE has actually seen substantial development. According to the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC), the UAE intends to produce 5 million barrels of oil per day by 2030, highlighting the relevance of neighborhood and worldwide contracting companies in attaining this goal.
In this blog, we will discover the leading 10 oil and gas contracting companies in Abu Dhabi, highlighting their functions and contributions to the industry.
Table of Contents
Toggle
1. Abu Dhabi National Oil Firm (ADNOC)
2. National Oil Building And Construction company (NPCC)
3. Technip Energies
4. McDermott International
5. Worley
6. AlMansoori Specialized engineering
7. Lamprell
8. Galfar Engineering & Contracting
9. Petrofac
10. Consolidated Contractors Company (CCC)
The Importance of Oil and Gas Contracting Company in Abu Dhabi
Conclusion
1. Abu Dhabi National Oil Firm (ADNOC)
ADNOC is the foundation of the UAE’s oil and gas industry. Developed in 1971, it has actually grown into a worldwide energy giant. ADNOC is accountable for supervising the exploration, production, and distribution of Abu Dhabi’s oil and gas reserves. With a workforce of over 60,000 staff members, ADNOC runs across the entire oil and gas value chain, making it the largest energy company in the UAE.
ADNOC’s subsidiaries, consisting of ADNOC Drilling and ADNOC Onshore, play a significant role in providing contracting services such as drilling, well services, and production enhancement. In 2024, ADNOC introduced a $15 billion investment to further enhance its upstream and downstream capacities, guaranteeing it stays at the leading edge of the international energy market.
2. National Oil Building And Construction company (NPCC)
NPCC is an additional significant player in Abu Dhabi’s oil and gas field. Established in 1973, NPCC specializes in engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for the offshore oil and gas industry. The company has completed numerous prominent projects in the UAE and throughout the Middle East, making it a recommended option for numerous oil and gas operators.
In 2024, NPCC increased its operations by acquiring a significant stake in a joint endeavor concentrated on offshore wind energy, showcasing its commitment to sustainability and the energy transition.
3. Technip Energies
Technip Energies, an international leader in energy transition projects, has a strong visibility in Abu Dhabi. The firm provides EPC services throughout various industries, including oil and gas, refining, and petrochemicals. Technip Energies is known for its cutting-edge services, particularly in offshore and LNG (dissolved natural gas) projects.
In 2024, Technip Energies secured a major contract with ADNOC to design and create a brand-new gas processing plant. This project intends to enhance the UAE’s gas outcome by 30%, further strengthening Technip’s setting as a crucial specialist in the region.
4. McDermott International
McDermott International has been a leading player in the oil and gas contracting market for years. The firm provides EPC services and concentrates on offshore platforms, pipelines, and storage centers. McDermott’s local head office in Abu Dhabi guarantees its close partnership with local drivers.
Since 2024, McDermott has been working on several massive offshore projects in the UAE, including the setup of subsea pipelines and the construction of offshore systems. The company’s concentration on technology and sustainability has actually made it a preferred service provider for projects connected to renewable energy integration.
5. Worley
Worley is a global engineering and construction company with a significant presence in Abu Dhabi’s oil and gas industry. Worley provides comprehensive project management, engineering, and getting in touch with services for both onshore and offshore projects. Its competence spans across the entire oil and gas value chain, from expedition to refining and petrochemicals.
In 2024, Worley announced a partnership with ADNOC to develop one of the world’s biggest carbon capture and storage (CCS) projects. This project intends to reduce Abu Dhabi’s carbon discharges by 40% by 2035, placing Worley as a principal in the area’s energy change.
6. AlMansoori Specialized engineering
AlMansoori Specialized Engineering is an Abu Dhabi-based oilfield services company that has been providing specialized engineering solutions to the oil and gas industry for over 4 decades. The firm offers a wide variety of services, consisting of well testing, drilling, and production enhancement.
In 2024, AlMansoori broadened its procedures right into renewable energy by introducing a brand-new department focused on solar energy projects. This action straightens with the UAE’s Vision 2050, which intends to produce 50% of its energy from sustainable resources.
7. Lamprell
Lamprell is a leading service provider specializing in the construction of offshore platforms, drilling rigs, and renewable energy infrastructure. Based in the UAE, Lamprell has delivered several top-level projects for clients like ADNOC and Saudi Aramco.
In 2024, Lamprell secured a contract to build one of the largest offshore wind farms in the Middle East, showcasing its ability to diversify its profile and add to the energy transition. The company’s experience in manufacture and construction makes it a top option for oil and gas projects in Abu Dhabi.
8. Galfar Engineering & Contracting
Galfar Engineering & Contracting is one of the largest engineering and construction companies in the Middle East. With its head office in Oman, Galfar has a solid presence in Abu Dhabi, supplying EPC services for oil and gas, infrastructure, and industrial projects.
In 2024, Galfar was awarded a contract to build a new petrochemical center in Abu Dhabi’s industrial zone, further solidifying its placement as a leading professional in the region’s oil and gas industry.
9. Petrofac
Petrofac is a UK-based oilfield services firm with a significant presence in Abu Dhabi. The company provides a variety of services, consisting of engineering, procurement, construction, and project management. Petrofac has been associated with numerous major projects in Abu Dhabi, including the development of gas processing plants and oil storage facilities.
In 2024, Petrofac announced a $2 billion contract with ADNOC to supply EPC services for a new offshore oilfield development. This project will certainly increase Abu Dhabi’s oil production capacity by 20%, making Petrofac a key companion in the emirate’s energy approach.
10. Consolidated Contractors Company (CCC)
Consolidated Contractors Company (CCC) is an international construction firm with a strong presence in the Middle East. CCC has actually been associated with several massive oil and gas projects in Abu Dhabi, consisting of the construction of pipelines, refineries, and petrochemical plants.
In 2024, CCC was awarded a contract to build a new LNG terminal in Abu Dhabi, further enhancing the emirate’s ability to export natural gas to global markets. CCC’s expertise in large facilities projects makes it a leading choice for oil and gas operators in the region.
The Importance of Oil and Gas Contracting Company in Abu Dhabi
The oil and gas contracting company in Abu Dhabi plays a critical role in sustaining the emirate’s energy passions. From exploration and production to refining and transportation, these companies offer the proficiency, innovation, and manpower needed to ensure the reliable operation of Abu Dhabi’s oil and gas industry.
As the UAE continues to expand its energy mix and invest in renewable energy, these companies are also playing a key role in the energy transition. By integrating cutting-edge options such as carbon capture, hydrogen manufacturing, and offshore wind farms, they are aiding to shape the future of the energy industry in Abu Dhabi.
Conclusion
One company that stands out in Abu Dhabi’s oil and gas field is The GET Global Group. As a trusted partner for energy firms in the area, the GET Global Group offers extensive services throughout the oil and gas value chain. From exploration and production to project management and maintenance, The GET Global Group has established itself as a leading provider of oil and gas services in Abu Dhabi.

The oil and gas pipeline fabrication and construction market is driven by rising energy demand, expansion of cross-border pipelines, infrastructure modernization, technological advancements, and increasing investments in upstream and midstream projects globally.
Introduction
The oil and gas pipeline fabrication and construction market refers to the design, manufacturing, and installation of pipelines used to transport crude oil, natural gas, and refined products across regions. The market is primarily driven by rising global energy demand, increasing cross-border pipeline projects, and the need to replace aging infrastructure. These pipelines are widely applied in upstream, midstream, and downstream operations to ensure efficient and safe energy transportation. Governments worldwide are supporting the sector through investments, favorable policies, and large-scale initiatives to strengthen energy security and expand national pipeline networks. Recent developments include new pipeline project approvals, strategic partnerships, and the expansion of liquefied natural gas infrastructure. Industry news highlights growing investments in emerging economies and increasing focus on sustainable energy transport solutions. Technological advancements such as smart pipeline monitoring systems, automation, advanced welding techniques, and corrosion-resistant materials are further enhancing pipeline efficiency, safety, and durability, contributing to steady market growth globally.

Regional growth and demand
Asia Pacific is expected to grow the fastest during the forecast period in the Oil and Gas Pipeline Fabrication and Construction market. The region’s rapid growth is driven by increasing energy demand due to industrialization and urbanization, along with expanding oil and gas exploration activities. Countries such as China, India, and Southeast Asian nations are investing heavily in cross-country pipeline networks, LNG infrastructure, and refinery expansions. Government initiatives supporting energy security, strategic petroleum reserves, and cross-border pipeline projects are further accelerating market growth. Additionally, the replacement of aging pipelines and rising focus on natural gas transportation are boosting fabrication and construction activities across the region.
North America is expected to generate the highest demand during the forecast period in the Oil and Gas Pipeline Fabrication and Construction market. Demand is driven by extensive shale oil and gas production, particularly in the United States and Canada, along with the modernization of aging pipeline infrastructure. Increasing investments in midstream projects, expansion of export terminals, and strong regulatory support for pipeline safety and efficiency contribute to market growth. Technological advancements in pipeline monitoring, automation, and corrosion prevention further support sustained demand in the region.

Increasing Investments in Pipeline Infrastructure
Governments and energy companies are heavily investing in pipeline fabrication and construction to support rising global energy demand. Large-scale cross-country and cross-border pipeline projects are being developed to ensure efficient transportation of crude oil and natural gas.
Growing Demand for Natural Gas Pipelines
The shift toward cleaner energy sources is increasing demand for natural gas pipelines. Countries are expanding gas distribution networks to reduce carbon emissions and meet energy transition goals.
Expansion of LNG Infrastructure
The growth of liquefied natural gas (LNG) projects is driving the need for pipeline connectivity between production sites, terminals, and end users, boosting fabrication and construction activities.
Replacement of Aging Pipeline Networks
Aging pipeline infrastructure, especially in developed regions, is being replaced or upgraded to improve safety, reduce leak risks, and enhance operational efficiency.

Saipem S.p.A.
Headquarters: Milan, Italy
Saipem is a global leader in engineering, procurement, construction, and installation (EPCI) services for the oil and gas sector, specializing in pipeline fabrication and construction across onshore and offshore environments. The company delivers complex pipeline projects including subsea pipelines, trunklines, and gas transportation systems. Saipem focuses on advanced welding technologies, digital project management, and sustainable construction practices. With a strong presence across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia, the company supports large-scale energy infrastructure and offshore developments.
McDermott International Ltd.
Headquarters: Houston, United States
McDermott International is a leading provider of integrated EPCI services for upstream and midstream oil and gas projects. The company specializes in offshore pipeline installation, subsea systems, and pipeline fabrication. Its advanced construction capabilities and global fabrication yards enable execution of complex deepwater and ultra-deepwater pipeline projects. McDermott emphasizes innovation, safety, and efficient project delivery across major energy markets.
TechnipFMC plc
Headquarters: London, United Kingdom
TechnipFMC is a prominent player in oil and gas engineering and construction, offering end-to-end solutions for pipeline fabrication, subsea infrastructure, and offshore developments. The company leverages advanced technologies such as digital engineering, automation, and subsea processing systems to enhance pipeline performance and reliability. Its global footprint and strategic partnerships support large-scale offshore and onshore pipeline projects.
Subsea 7 S.A.
Headquarters: Luxembourg
Subsea 7 specializes in offshore energy projects, particularly subsea pipeline installation and fabrication. The company delivers engineering and construction services for complex pipeline systems in deepwater environments. Its expertise includes rigid pipeline installation, subsea structures, and inspection services. Subsea 7 focuses on technological innovation and efficient project execution to support global offshore energy developments.
Bechtel Corporation
Headquarters: Virginia, United States
Bechtel is one of the world’s largest engineering and construction companies, with extensive experience in oil and gas pipeline infrastructure. The company provides end-to-end services, including design, fabrication, and construction of large-scale pipelines and LNG facilities. Bechtel is known for delivering complex cross-country pipeline projects and emphasizes safety, sustainability, and advanced engineering solutions in energy infrastructure development.
